Name: Serah, Daughter of Asher
Summary: Daughter of Asher, named as sister of Imnah, Isuah, Ishuai, and Beriah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:30: Daughter of Asher, named as sister of Imnah, Isuah, Ishuai, and Beriah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Serah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
